# Version 4.159.0
> **Custom meshes and Skia m159** · [NuGet (prerelease)](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.159.0-preview.1.26563.22)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.159.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/15.0.0.100/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.159.0 introduces custom GPU mesh drawing alongside the Skia m159 engine. The cumulative line adds mesh specifications and builders, corrects iOS and tvOS device frameworks, and improves glyph and image-filter handling. WebAssembly native assets now require .NET 9 or later.

## Breaking Changes

- **Upgrade WebAssembly consumers to .NET 9 or later** — SkiaSharp and HarfBuzzSharp no longer provide .NET 8 WebAssembly native assets. Retarget WASM applications to .NET 9 or later and use the runtime-matched assets; newer archives are not interchangeable with older toolchains. Non-WebAssembly .NET 8 support is unchanged. ([#5700](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5700))

## Engine

- **Skia m159 engine improvements** — Brings WebAssembly SIMD CPU rasterization, Windows font-loading improvements, and upstream image and rendering corrections. ([#5685](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5685))

## API Surface

- **Custom GPU vertex meshes** — SKMeshSpecification, indexed and non-indexed builders, vertex and index buffers, and SKCanvas.DrawMesh expose SkSL-based custom meshes with uniforms and child effects. Drawing requires a GPU-backed surface; raster drawing is a no-op. Built meshes retain native resources after their source wrappers are disposed; buffer updates require 4-byte alignment. ([#5760](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5760))

## Bug Fixes

- **Correct Apple device frameworks** — SkiaSharp and HarfBuzzSharp iOS and tvOS device frameworks now contain arm64 device binaries and matching platform metadata, avoiding simulator slices that could cause App Store ITMS-90087 rejection. Separate simulator frameworks retain x86_64 and arm64 support. — ❤️ [@kdpkke](https://github.com/kdpkke) ([#5649](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5649))
- **Safer glyph masks and Vulkan allocation failure handling** — Mask-filtered glyph reloads now respect changed paths and formats, prevent sub-byte overwrites, and preserve clipped emboss-plane strides. A targeted Imagination Vulkan workaround abandons descriptor pools after host or device allocation OOM to avoid driver failures during destruction. ([#5741](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5741))
- **Consistent image-filter cache keys** — Matches cache-key equality to its bytewise hash, accounting for signed-zero representations and matrix type metadata so key lookup, eviction, and purge use consistent identity rules. ([#5769](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5769))

## HarfBuzzSharp 15.0.0.100

HarfBuzzSharp 15.0.0.100 retains native HarfBuzz 15.0.0. WebAssembly assets now require .NET 9 or later, and iOS/tvOS device frameworks use device-only binaries and metadata while simulator support is preserved.

## Preview 1 (November 14, 2026)

Preview 1 brings Skia m159 with WebAssembly SIMD rasterization and Windows font-loading improvements. WebAssembly consumers require .NET 9 or later; non-WASM .NET 8 support is unchanged.
